incident_type.description: Category of the incident as described by the caller. violent_incident, suicide_or_attempt and extended_absence relate to the December 2025 model amendments, which apply only where adopted locally.

arose_from_work.description: The incident happened as a result of work (arising from the conduct of the business or undertaking).

serious_injury_criteria_met.description: For injury_or_illness: the caller has checked the injury or illness against the statutory serious injury or illness criteria. Prefer injury_categories, which the API checks for you; this field is used only when injury_categories is absent.

serious_risk_exposed.description: For dangerous_incident: the incident immediately or imminently exposed a person to a serious risk to health or safety. Required for the incident to be notifiable, together with a category (dangerous_incident_categories).

injury_categories.description: For injury_or_illness: which statutory serious injury or illness categories apply (model WHS Act s 36). A category applies if the injury or illness would ordinarily require the immediate treatment described, whether or not treatment is available or sought. Send ["none_of_these"] if none apply. pelvis_skull_or_facial_fracture, other_serious_fracture, serious_crush_injury and serious_brain_injury_from_blows were added by the December 2025 model amendments and apply only where adopted locally. When present, this takes precedence over serious_injury_criteria_met.

dangerous_incident_categories.description: For dangerous_incident: which statutory dangerous incident categories apply (model WHS Act s 37). Also set serious_risk_exposed: a category is notifiable only if it immediately or imminently exposes a person to a serious risk. mobile_plant_incident and serious_fall_of_a_person were added by the December 2025 model amendments and apply only where adopted locally. Send ["none_of_these"] if none apply.
